description: Header file defining the StackFrameSymbolizer class, which encapsulates logic for symbolizing stack frames in crash reporting, including resolving source line info, and managing symbol modules.

classes.name: StackFrameSymbolizer
classes.description: A class responsible for symbolizing stack frames by interacting with symbol suppliers and source line resolvers.

methods.name: FillSourceLineInfo
methods.description: Resolves source line information for a given stack frame.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Finds Windows-specific frame information for a given stack frame.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Finds CFI (Call Frame Information) for a given stack frame.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, clearing known missing symbol modules.

methods.name: HasImplementation
methods.description: Checks if the symbolizer has a valid implementation.
